title: Blessings jar
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y3 lesson 20 (Pupil PDF worksheet: blessings jar)
intro: Lesson 20: Counting blessings. To understand that Allah's blessings are too many to count and that noticing them makes us grateful

questions.q: Name five blessings in one minute.
questions.a: For example: eyes, water, family, home, Islam
questions.model: Teacher counts aloud: 'my eyes, my hands, water, my mum, the Qur'an: five!'

questions.q: Which is a blessing of faith?
On the pupil PDF, make a 'Blessings jar': write ten blessings on the jar strips, two from each group (body, home, food, people, faith).
questions.a: Ten blessings, two in each group
questions.model: Teacher writes the first two in 'body': 'my eyes', 'my legs to walk to the masjid'.

questions.q: choose one blessing and write how you will use it to please Allah.
questions.a: For example: my eyes to read Qur'an

questions.q: why does looking at those who have less make us grateful?
questions.a: We notice what we have and stop envying

questions.q: Can we count all Allah's blessings?
Back to our ponder: when would you finish counting your blessings?
